column2: He went after the wrong guy.
I ignored a bounty hunter.
Found you
He found your house.
The police set up a tip line just for your case.
Flood it with fake tips
The tip line is drowning in nonsense. Real tips are getting lost.
I flooded the police tip line with fake tips.
One of the calls was traced back to you.
Call in a tip about yourself
You described yourself perfectly, then hung up. The recording went viral.
I called the police tip line and described myself.
Too close
They traced the call before you hung up.
You didn't call.
I ignored the police tip line.
Someone online says they're {1}'s biggest fan and wants to meet in person.
Meet them
They cried when they realized it was really you. They'll never tell anyone.
I met my biggest fan in person.
The "superfan" was an undercover cop.
Send them a signed note
They posted your note online. It's been shared a million times.
I sent a signed note to my biggest fan.
Police compared your handwriting to old evidence.
Block them
You blocked them.
I blocked a superfan.
The police released a brand new sketch of the killer. It looks nothing like you.
You're in the clear. For now.
The police released a sketch that looked nothing like me.
Mail them a "correction"
The police chief read your letter on TV, furious. You're a legend now.
I mailed the police a correction to their sketch.
Your "correction" was a little too accurate.
Change your look anyway
Better safe than sorry.
I changed my look just in case.
A local politician is promising to catch the killer before the election.
Send them a threatening letter
Your letter made national news. Their campaign is falling apart.
I sent a threatening letter to a politician.
Federal agents are now involved.
Donate to their opponent
Their opponent won. The investigation lost funding.
I donated to the opponent of a politician who wanted to catch me.
Politicians always promise things.
I ignored a politician's promise to catch me.
{1}'s dog keeps showing up at your front door.
Adopt it
New best friend
The dog sleeps at the foot of your bed now.
I adopted my victim's dog.
A vet scanned its microchip and called the police.
You dropped it off anonymously.
I took a stray dog to the shelter.
The shelter's camera got a clear shot of your face.
Eventually it stopped coming back.
I ignored a stray dog.
Your coworkers won't stop talking about {1} at lunch.
Share your "theories"
Office expert
Everyone thinks you're a true crime genius.
I shared my theories about the killer with my coworkers.
Slip of the tongue
You mentioned a detail that was never released. Someone noticed.
Small talk
You talked about the weather instead.
I changed the subject when coworkers talked about the killer.
Report a coworker as suspicious
The police questioned your coworker for hours. They're looking at the wrong person.
I reported a coworker to the police as a suspect.
Your coworker had an alibi, and now the police want to talk to the person who reported them.
Late Night Joke
A late night talk show host made a whole monologue about {1}.
Call the show
You got through and the host went pale. The clip has 30 million views.
I called a late night talk show about me.
The network gave the call records to the FBI.
Honestly, some of the jokes were pretty good.
I laughed at a talk show joke about me.
Send the host a gift
The host announced on air that the killer sent him a gift. Ratings exploded.
I sent a talk show host a gift.
Return address
There was a fingerprint on the wrapping paper.
A forensic TV show reconstructed one of your murders and got everything wrong.
Correct them online
Fact check
Fans are calling your post the real answer. The show had to issue a correction.
I corrected a forensic TV show about my murder online.
The police wondered how you knew.
Feel relieved
If that's what they think happened, you're safe.
A crime show got my murder completely wrong.
You turned it off.
I ignored a crime show about me.
Kids posted a video of a weapon they found in a creek. It's yours.
Buy it from them
You told the kids you collect old knives and paid them cash. They deleted the video.
I bought my old weapon back from some kids.
One of the kids' parents remembered your face and called the police.
Comment that it's a prank
Everyone believed it was fake.
I convinced people a video of my weapon was a prank.
Turned in
The kids turned it in to the police anyway.
The kids lost it in the creek again.
I ignored a video of my old weapon.
The police collected it for testing.
An old classmate posted your yearbook photo online with the caption "Remember this weird kid?"
Get it taken down
You reported it and the post was removed.
I got an old yearbook photo of me taken down.
People already took screenshots, and someone compared it to the police sketch.
Message the classmate
You laughed it off with them. They deleted it.
I messaged an old classmate about my yearbook photo.
Creeped out
They said you gave them chills and blocked you.
Nobody cares about old yearbook photos.
I ignored an old yearbook photo of me.
A local ghost tour now stops at your crime scenes.
Join the tour
The guide got almost everything wrong. You tipped him anyway.
I joined a ghost tour of my own crime scenes.
Someone on the tour kept staring at you.
Correct the tour guide
The tour group was amazed by how much you knew.
I corrected a tour guide about my own murders.
A retired cop on the tour wrote down your license plate.
You avoided that part of town.
I ignored the ghost tour.
Letters addressed to {1} keep showing up at a P.O. box people think is yours. It is.
Read them all
Fan mail
Hundreds of letters. Some of them are proposals.
I read my fan mail.
Write back to one
Pen pal
Your reply was posted online and shared everywhere.
I wrote back to a fan.
The police were watching the post office when you picked up the mail.
Close the P.O. box
Better not to leave a trail.
I closed my P.O. box.
The detective who has chased you for years announced their retirement.
Send a retirement card
The detective held up your card at their retirement party. The whole department was furious.
I sent the detective chasing me a retirement card.
Last case
The detective used the card to crack your case on their last day.
You opened a bottle of champagne alone.
I celebrated the retirement of the detective chasing me.
A new detective will take over.
I ignored the detective's retirement.
True Crime Convention
A true crime convention is holding a huge panel about {1}.
Attend in disguise
You sat in the front row of a panel about yourself.
I went to a true crime convention panel about myself.
Facial recognition
The convention center had facial recognition cameras.
Ask the panel a question
You asked a question only the killer could answer. The room went silent. The clip went viral.
I asked a panel about my murders a question only I could answer.
Security held you until the police arrived.
You watched the livestream.
I watched a true crime panel about me online.
Cold Case Lab
A crime lab is retesting evidence from one of your old scenes.
Break into the lab
You destroyed the evidence. The case is cold again.
I broke into a crime lab and destroyed evidence.
Lab security caught you on camera.
Bribe a lab tech
The lab tech "accidentally" contaminated the sample.
I bribed a lab tech to ruin evidence against me.
The lab tech reported the bribe.
Wait and hope
The results were inconclusive.
The lab retest on my old case came back inconclusive.
The DNA matched someone in your family's ancestry account.
A random attention seeker went on TV claiming to be {1}.
Expose them
The real one
You sent proof only the real killer could have. The impostor was humiliated, and you're bigger than ever.
I exposed someone falsely claiming to be me.
The "proof" you sent gave the police something new to work with.
The police wasted months on the impostor.
I let someone falsely claim to be me.
Mock them online
Your post mocking the impostor went viral.
I mocked an impostor online.
Your account was traced.
The anniversary of your first murder is all over the news.
Celebrate quietly
I quietly celebrated the anniversary of my first murder.
Leave a calling card at the scene
Calling card
The police found your card the next morning. The news ran nothing else all week.
I left a calling card at the scene of my first murder.
Detectives were watching the scene that night.
Just another day
You went to work like normal.
I ignored the anniversary of my first murder.
Study the task force
Know your enemy
You learned every detective's name and where they park.
I studied the task force formed to catch me.
A detective noticed you hanging around the precinct.
Send them a welcome letter
The task force leader read your letter at a press conference, shaking with anger.
I sent the new task force a welcome letter.
They pulled a print off the envelope.
You stayed out of sight while they got organized.
I laid low after a task force was formed to catch me.
The tip line for your case has gotten 10,000 calls. Almost all of them are useless.
Add a few more useless ones
Your fake tips disappeared in the flood.
I called in fake tips to the hotline for my own case.
An analyst flagged your voice.
Call in a real clue
You gave them one tiny real detail. The media went into a frenzy.
I gave the hotline a real clue about my own case.
Too real
They traced the call.
Let them drown in calls.
I ignored the tip line for my case.
The FBI's secret profile of the killer was leaked online. Some of it is scarily accurate.
Change everything it says about you
New habits
You changed your car, your gym and your coffee order.
I changed my habits after the FBI profile leaked.
Post a review of it
Your "review" of the profile went viral. People are calling it the coldest thing they've ever read.
I posted a review of the FBI profile of me.
The FBI traced the post.
It's just paper.
I ignored the leaked FBI profile.
The city cut funding for the task force hunting you.
Fewer detectives, more freedom.
The task force hunting me lost its funding.
Strike again to embarrass the city
The mayor restored the funding the next day, red-faced.
I struck again right after the task force lost funding.
You rushed it.
Send the mayor a thank-you note
Thank you
The mayor's office leaked your note. The city is furious at the mayor.
I sent the mayor a thank-you note for cutting the task force.
Your handwriting is now in an FBI database.
The lead detective on your case is sleeping at the office. Their marriage is falling apart.
Send flowers to their spouse
Mind games
The detective broke down on camera. Your fans loved it.
I sent flowers to the spouse of the detective hunting me.
The florist remembered you.
Feel a little sorry for them
For a second, you almost felt bad.
I felt sorry for the detective hunting me.
You know where they eat, sleep and drink now.
I studied the routine of the detective hunting me.
The detective spotted you watching them.
{1}'s family put up a billboard with a reward, right on the highway you drive every day.
You avoid that highway now.
I started avoiding the billboard about my victim.
Vandalize the billboard
Photos of the vandalized billboard made national news.
I vandalized a billboard about one of my victims.
A traffic camera caught your car.
Call the number on it
You described the killer as "tall, with a mustache." You have neither.
I called the reward number on a billboard about my victim.
The family's private investigator recorded the call.
Case Goes Cold
After {1}, the police officially declared your case cold.
Relax for the first time in years
You slept through the night for the first time in years.
The police declared my case cold.
Remind them you're still out there
Still here
The case was reopened the same day. You're back on the front page.
I reminded the police I was still out there after they declared my case cold.
Your reminder gave them a brand new lead.
Cold is good.
I ignored the news that my case went cold.
The detective who has hunted you for years was transferred to a desk job.
The new detective doesn't know half of what the old one did.
The detective hunting me was transferred.
Send the old detective a goodbye gift
The old detective framed your note in their new office. They haven't given up.
I sent the transferred detective a goodbye gift.
Your gift got them put back on the case.
Size up the new detective
The new detective is young and sloppy.
I sized up the new detective on my case.
The new detective is sharper than the old one.
A news channel aired a special for the anniversary of {1}'s first murder.
Watch it with popcorn
They used the wrong photo of the crime scene.
I watched an anniversary special about my murders.
Call in live
The anchor's face went white. The clip is everywhere.
I called in live during an anniversary special about my murders.
The network traced the call.
You went to bed early.
I turned off the anniversary special about me.
Suspect List Leaked
A list of suspects in your case leaked online. Your name is on it.
Get ahead of it publicly
Victim of the internet
You gave an interview about being falsely accused. People felt sorry for you.
I gave an interview about being falsely named as a suspect.
Too rehearsed
Detectives said your interview sounded rehearsed.
Lay very low
Nobody paid attention to the 47th name on the list.
I laid low after my name showed up on a leaked suspect list.
Internet sleuths posted your home address.
Sue whoever leaked it
The city settled out of court. You got paid.
I sued over a leaked suspect list.
The lawsuit forced you to answer questions under oath.
Police are now linking old missing persons cases to you. Some of them weren't even yours.
Let them think it was you
Your body count keeps growing in the press.
Police started blaming me for missing persons cases that weren't mine.
Send proof the extras weren't you
The police had to admit there's another killer out there.
I sent the police proof that some missing persons cases weren't mine.
Your proof included a detail they could use.
More suspects means more confusion.
I ignored the missing persons cases linked to me.
A huge online group of amateur sleuths is trying to solve your case. They're getting close.
Join the group undercover
You became a moderator and steered them in the wrong direction for a year.
I joined an online group trying to solve my own case.
Another member traced your account.
Post a cryptic clue
The group went into a frenzy trying to decode it.
They decoded it in a day.
Gave up
The group fell apart over arguments.
I ignored the internet sleuths.
They posted a theory that's almost exactly right.
Cold Case Unit
After {1}, a cold case unit reopened your files with fresh eyes.
Destroy anything left over
Clean slate
You burned the last few things you had kept.
I destroyed my last souvenirs after the cold case unit reopened my case.
Watch them from a distance
They don't have anything new.
I watched the cold case unit from a distance.
A cold case detective noticed you twice.
Leave them a souvenir
They found a souvenir from your first murder on their doorstep. The case is headline news again.
I left a souvenir for the cold case unit.
The souvenir had your DNA on it.
Reporters found out the police lost a box of evidence from your case.
Whatever was in that box is gone forever.
The police lost a box of evidence from my case.
Mail them a replacement "clue"
The police chief resigned in embarrassment.
I mailed the police a replacement clue after they lost evidence.
Your clue was more useful than you meant it to be.
Good news is good news.
I ignored the lost evidence story.
A retired cop has spent his whole retirement hunting you in his basement.
Find out what he has
His basement wall is full of the wrong people.
I found out what the retired cop hunting me knows.
Your photo
Your photo is pinned in the middle of his wall.
Pay him a visit
Gone quiet
He stopped posting about the case after your visit.
I paid a visit to the retired cop hunting me.
He recognized you the second he opened the door.
He's just an old man with a corkboard.
I ignored the retired cop hunting me.
He sent the police a tip that actually helped.
Investigators uploaded crime scene DNA to a genealogy website. They're building your family tree.
Convince your relatives to delete their accounts
Branch cut
Your cousins deleted their accounts. The tree dead-ends.
I convinced my relatives to delete their genealogy accounts.
Suspicious cousin
A cousin asked why you cared so much.
Upload fake family DNA
Wrong tree
Investigators are now hunting a family in another country.
I uploaded fake DNA to a genealogy site.
The site traced the fake upload to your IP.
The search hit a dead end.
A genealogy search for me hit a dead end.
Close relative
They found your second cousin.
Detective's Book
The lead detective wrote a bestselling book about failing to catch you.
You now know every mistake they made.
I read the detective's book about failing to catch me.
Leave a review
Your one-star review called out details only the killer would know. It went viral.
I left a review of the detective's book about me.
The detective handed your review to the FBI.
Go to their book signing
They signed your copy "To my biggest fan." If only they knew.
I got the detective's book signed at a book signing.
The detective stared at you for a long time.
The only witness in your case recanted their story. They say their memory is gone.
Breathe easy
The case just lost its best lead.
The only witness in my case recanted.
Send them flowers
The witness moved away the next week.
I sent flowers to the witness who recanted.
The witness took your flowers to the police.
One less problem.
I ignored the witness recanting.
A dying man confessed to being {1}. He wasn't.
Let him take it to the grave
The police happily closed the case.
A dying man falsely confessed to my murders, and I let it go.
Prove he was lying
Not him
You proved he was lying. The whole country realized the killer is still out there.
I proved that a man's deathbed confession to my crimes was fake.
Your proof handed the police a new lead.
Visit him in the hospital
Last words
He looked at you and smiled. "I know who you are." Then he died.
I visited the dying man who confessed to my crimes.
Told the nurse
He pointed at you and told the nurse.
A streaming service is making a big new documentary about {1}.
Submit an anonymous interview
Your anonymous voice is the most talked-about part of the documentary.
I gave an anonymous interview to a new documentary about me.
Voice analysis
A voice analyst on the show compared you to old recordings.
It's good. Mostly wrong, but good.
I watched the new documentary about me.
You've seen enough of yourself on TV.
I ignored the new documentary about me.
The original detective's daughter joined the force and took over your case.
Watch her carefully
She's smart, but she's still learning.
I started watching the new detective on my case.
Better than her father
She found something her father missed.
Send her a message about her father
She went on TV in tears. Your fans went wild.
I sent the detective a message about her father.
She used your message to get a warrant.
She's just another cop.
I ignored the new detective on my case.
She won't stop digging.
Old Car Found
Your old car turned up in a junkyard. Investigators are swabbing the trunk.
Get to the junkyard first
You paid the junkyard owner to crush it before anyone could test it.
I had my old car crushed before investigators could test it.
Caught there
Investigators were already at the junkyard when you showed up.
Report it stolen years ago
Your "stolen car" report confused the investigation.
I claimed my old car was stolen years ago.
No report
There's no record of you ever reporting it stolen.
Hope nothing's left
Years of rain washed everything away.
My old car turned up clean.
They found a strand of hair in the trunk.
Ten years after your first unsolved murder, every news channel is running specials about you.
Celebrate the anniversary
Ten years. Nobody has caught you yet.
I celebrated ten years of being uncaught.
Send the media a "10 year" letter
Your letter is the biggest story in the country.
I sent the media a letter on the tenth anniversary of my murders.
Final clue
Your letter gave them the break they needed.
Just another year
I ignored the ten year anniversary of my murders.
All Grown Up
{1}'s child grew up and became a police officer, just to catch you.
Watch them carefully
They're driven, but they're not good at this yet.
I started watching my victim's child, who became a cop.
They found something new.
Send them an anonymous apology
They read your apology on TV. The whole country cried.
I sent my victim's child an anonymous apology.
There was a print on the letter.
You don't look back.
I ignored my victim's child joining the police.
Investigators exhumed {1}'s body for new tests.
Hope time erased everything
The new tests found nothing.
An exhumation of one of my victims found nothing.
They found a fiber from your old jacket.
Get rid of anything that could match
You burned your old clothes, shoes and tools.
I destroyed anything that could match evidence from an exhumation.
Watch from the cemetery
Nobody noticed one more mourner.
I watched the exhumation of my victim from the cemetery.
A detective photographed everyone at the cemetery.
A new generation of teenagers is obsessed with {1}. Some of them want to be you.
Enjoy the attention
You're a legend to people who weren't even born yet.
A new generation became obsessed with me.
Post anonymous "advice" online
Your posts got millions of views before they were taken down.
I posted anonymous messages for my young fans.
The FBI tracked the posts.
Kids these days.
I ignored my young fans.
You've become an urban legend. Kids tell ghost stories about {1} at sleepovers.
Live up to the legend
The stories got even scarier.
I lived up to my urban legend.
Someone matched the "legend" to a real person.
Enjoy being a myth
Half the town doesn't believe you were ever real.
I became an urban legend.
Just stories.
I ignored the urban legend about me.
The original detective on your case is dying. They want to know the truth before they go.
Send them an anonymous confession
The detective died with your letter in their hand. The media called it "the end of an era."
I sent the dying detective an anonymous confession.
The detective gave your letter to the police before dying.
Visit them in hospice
Final meeting
They squeezed your hand and smiled. They knew. They never told anyone.
I visited the dying detective who hunted me.
With their last breath, they said your name to a nurse.
Let them die wondering
They died never knowing for sure.
The detective who hunted me died without answers.
Twenty years have passed since your first unsolved murder. The case is still open.
Feel untouchable
Twenty years. You're a ghost.
Twenty years passed and my case was still unsolved.
Give the world one last clue
The country is obsessed with you all over again.
I gave the world one last clue twenty years later.
The end
The last clue was one too many.
You're older now. Quieter.
I ignored the twentieth anniversary of my murders.
The city built a memorial for your victims. Every name is carved in stone.
Visit the memorial
You read every name. You remembered every one.
I visited the memorial for my victims.
Undercover officers were watching the memorial.
Leave something at the memorial
The object you left made headlines across the country.
I left something at the memorial for my victims.
They lifted prints off it.
You never went.
I stayed away from the memorial for my victims.
The media has moved on. Young people have never heard of you.
Remind them who you are
Your name is trending for the first time in years.
I reminded the world who I am.
Too old for this
You made a mistake you never would have made twenty years ago.
Being forgotten is the best way to never get caught.
I accepted that the world forgot about me.
Write your memoir in secret
You wrote everything down and hid it. Someone will find it after you're gone.
I secretly wrote my memoir.
event
Case Open For
You stayed up all night watching documentaries about famous serial killers.
I took notes while watching serial killer documentaries.
You filled a whole notebook with what the famous ones did wrong.
Feel sick and turn it off
I turned off a serial killer documentary feeling sick.
You turned it off halfway through. The thoughts didn't stop.
Burn the notebook
I burned my notebook full of dark thoughts.
No evidence. Not that there's anything to find yet.
Someone at the grocery store caught you staring at them a little too long.
Smile and wave
I smiled at a stranger who caught me staring.
They smiled back, a little confused.
A stranger complained to the manager that I was staring.
They told the store manager a creep was watching them.
Look away fast
I looked away when a stranger caught me staring.
Looked away
Your heart was pounding the whole way home.
Keep staring
I kept staring at a stranger until they left the store.
They abandoned their cart and walked out.
You haven't slept properly in weeks. You keep imagining what it would feel like.
Go for a walk at night
I walked the empty streets at night to clear my head.
Night walk
The streets are so quiet at 3 AM. Anyone could be out here alone.
Try sleeping pills
Out cold
You slept for fourteen hours. The thoughts were still there when you woke up.
Call a crisis line
I called a crisis line about my dark thoughts.
Talked it out
You hung up feeling a little lighter.
serial

Now that I'm out of prison, everyone knows who I am. People started following me online.
. You're the "{1}"
You're out of prison, and the whole world knows your face now{1}.
True crime fans are following your every move online.
The {1} I had on ice went rotten.
a rotten organ

I never got rid of {1}'s body, so it's still hidden at my house.

You never got rid of {1}'s body. Someone found it, and the police are swarming the area.
